mapper.sql: id, file_name, normalized_sha256, parser_version, document_id, status, attempts, last_error, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ingest_job (file_name, normalized_sha256, parser_version, status, attempts, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{fileName}, #{sha}, #{parserVersion}, 'PENDING', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ingest_job WHERE normalized_sha256 = #{sha} AND parser_version = #{parserVersion}
mapper.update: UPDATE ingest_job SET status = 'PENDING', file_name = #{fileName}, attempts = 0, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED'
UPDATE ingest_job SET status = 'RUNNING', attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE ingest_job SET status = CASE WHEN #{terminal} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, last_error = #{error}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'SUCCEEDED'
